name: Best of Both
tagline: The balanced main plan: one short Hakone–Fuji car trip from Kawasaki to Mishima, one Osaka hotel for 5 nights, and 5 nights in Hokkaido, with only 5 hotels.
summary: 3 nights in Shinjuku with a full anime day and a Girls Band Cry day in Kawasaki, where Pegasis picks up a car for Daikoku, the Turnpike and Fuji. One Fuji-view villa night, then the car goes back at Mishima and the Shinkansen takes you to one Osaka hotel for Nara, Suzuka, Kyoto, Kobe and Liberty Walk. A JAL flight to Hokkaido: 3 nights in Kutchan for skiing (Pegasis teaches Aoki) and the Rusutsu drift course, 2 nights in Sapporo with the Asahiyama penguins. Pegasis comes with one backpack: winter layers on day 1, a jacket on day 4, all ski gear rented at Hirafu, a suitcase bought on day 1 and sent ahead to Osaka; his layers, gloves and hat stay in the backpack with him.

who.pegasis: In: 24 of 25 WANTs. Daikoku (you drive, no guide, Tatsumi PA after), Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets (also your Hokkaido jacket), TMG view, Isetan depachika, Skyliner instead of N'EX, Omoide/Golden Gai, Radio Kaikan, Maidreamin, Ikebukuro goods route, Nakano, SHELTER with a live show, Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart and the Tokaido car road (as Hakone–Fuji by car + Suzuka + Nagoya), Niseko Grand Hirafu, Rusutsu drift (30-min self-drive course at 15:00), Asahiyama penguins, GARAKU, Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Onuma (2 h south of Niseko, a whole extra day). Your maybes in: Chureito, Lake Kawaguchi, Kobe beef, Osu, Nijo Market, the Kawasaki GBC walk. Kept short for you: Enoshima (1 h); Aoki's solo stops (Suga, Nissan Crossing, the car museum, Kyoto temples) happen while you shop or sleep.
who.aoki: In: about 43 of 49 WANTs. Omoide/Golden Gai, Suga stairs, Tokyo Station dome and Hachiko (GBC Tokyo), Nissan Crossing, TMG, Radio Kaikan, ZEST, Nakano and used goods, Ikebukuro, Shimokita and a SHELTER live show, Shibuya Sky before 15:00 + Nintendo/Pokémon, the Kawasaki GBC stamp walk (Lazona, Miharashi, East Exit plaza, Marufuku, CLUB CITTA'), Daikoku + Tatsumi, Enoshima + Slam Dunk crossing, Hakone as Tokyo-3, Fuji Motorsports Museum, Lake Kawaguchi, Hanz villa, Yuru Camp Motosu, Nara fire, Suzuka, Toyota museum, Inari dawn + Kinkakuji, Sabbat places (Kyoto, Osaka, Kobe), Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Donki coupon, two Niseko ski days on the beginner area (Pegasis teaches you, no paid lesson), Rusutsu drift (back seat of Pegasis's course, or a pro ride), Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Yokohama Chinatown and Cup Noodles (no time on the Kawasaki day; Kobe's Nankinmachi instead), GBC Yako stamps, Fujiten ski (Niseko instead), the paid maid-café tour (two maid cafés on your own instead), Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Aokana/Goto (off route), Toyota Kaikan (closed Sundays). Uji is skipped because you marked it not interested.
